universe: current SSE/SZSE mainboard; exclude currently ST/delisting names; historical membership unavailable
selection: each calendar month, top 30 by mean (high-low)/open over 20 completed daily bars strictly before selection date; first selection on 2026-04-27 close
entry: Monday low - 0.618 * Monday range, buy limit rounded down to cent; Tuesday-Friday; at most one new leg per stock/week
target: same Monday high + 0.618 * Monday range, rounded up to cent; frozen until exit
settlement: T+1, no same-day sells; 100-share entry lots
